description: This file is a shell script used for testing basic Git plumbing commands and functionalities. It contains a series of setup, validation, and testing steps that invoke Git commands such as update-index, write-tree, ls-files, commit-tree, and more, along with test assertions to verify correctness. The script is part of a test suite for Git, checking object IDs, tree structures, index operations, and other core features.

methods.name: try_local_xy
methods.description: Defines a shell function that tests support for local variable declarations in shell environments.

methods.name: test_oid
methods.description: Retrieves object IDs for specific objects such as zero, raw size, hex size, and specific hash algorithms.

methods.name: test_set_hash
methods.description: Configures the hash algorithm (e.g., sha1 or sha256) used for testing object IDs.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks whether the specified path is a file.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks whether the specified path is missing.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for equality.

methods.name: test_stdout_line_count
methods.description: Counts the number of lines in standard output or a file.

methods.name: test_ln_s_add
methods.description: Creates symbolic links and adds them to Git index, used for setting up test scenarios.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks whether specific prerequisites are satisfied before running certain tests.

methods.name: test_set_prereq
methods.description: Sets prerequisites required for subsequent tests.

methods.name: test_bool_env
methods.description: Tests environment variables for boolean values and proper handling.

methods.name: test_detect_hash
methods.description: Detects and verifies the hashing algorithm used in current environment.

methods.name: test_show_oid_info
methods.description: Outputs detailed information about object IDs for verification.
